source: color palette extracted from Clause-style reference video (deep forest green + warm greige + lime accent); structure/components adapted from earlier Skymetrics-style reference

meta.name: RealWise Design System
meta.usage: Shared token set consumed by three surfaces: admin-ui (internal), business-dashboard (tenant web), chat-ui (public, mobile-first). One token source, three renderers.

display.usage: page titles, KPI figures, chat greeting — carries brand personality

mono.usage: tabular numbers, data tables, currency, timestamps, spreadsheet-style grids

iconography.style: outline/stroke only, 1.5px stroke, 20-22px grid, rounded joins
iconography.set: Lucide (or equivalent single consistent outline set)
iconography.rule: never mix filled and outline icons; never use emoji as a functional icon

elevation.none: none — flat surfaces are the default, shadow is reserved for floating layers only

sidebarNav.pattern: fixed-width left rail, icon+label rows, active row = soft accent bg + accent ink text, collapse toggle in header, logo+wordmark at top, secondary items (help/settings) pinned to bottom
sidebarNav.mobileBehavior: collapses to bottom tab bar on <768px for business-dashboard and admin-ui; chat-ui has no sidebar at all on mobile, header-only

kpiCard.pattern: label top-left, delta pill top-right (positive=green soft pill + up-arrow, negative=red soft pill + down-arrow), large tabular-num value, one-line caption below

chartCard.pattern: title + one-line description, legend as inline dot+label+value (not a separate box), dashed horizontal gridlines only, single or dual line series, emphasized end-point dot, tooltip card on hover with timestamp + value
chartCard.gauge: semi-circle arc, thin stroke, accent color fill proportional to value, big tabular number centered under the arc, label below

pillBadge.pattern: rounded-full, soft-tint background matching semantic color, small arrow glyph + percentage, 11-12px font, bold

dataTable.pattern: no vertical rules, thin horizontal row dividers, uppercase tracked column labels in muted color, numeric columns right-aligned with tabular-nums, row hover = subtle bg tint only

chatPanel.pattern: assistant turn = plain text on canvas bg (no bubble), user turn = right-aligned filled pill/bubble, inline action row under each assistant turn (copy / thumbs-up / thumbs-down / regenerate) as small ghost icon buttons, input bar pinned bottom with rounded-full container, mode label chip inside input (e.g. an assistant-mode indicator) to the left of the submit button
chatPanel.structuredResult: when the assistant produces a table/report, render it as a separate side/below card with its own header row (icon + title + action icons: copy, like, dislike, refresh) — the conversational answer and the structured artifact are visually distinct panels, not inlined as chat text

historySidebar.pattern: grouped by relative date (Today / Yesterday / Last 7 days), each item truncated single line, active item = soft bg pill, New chat + Back + mode-switch actions pinned above the grouped list

motion.rule: respect prefers-reduced-motion; no decorative animation, only state-transition feedback
